subject: BrightWave: exemption evidence & plan to release invoice #4459
messages:
From: Megan Torres <megan.torres@brightwave.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sales tax certificate for Redwood invoice 4459 (NJ)

Hi Jonas,

We're attaching BrightWave's resale certificate for New Jersey to support tax-exempt treatment on invoice 4459. Our AP team placed the invoice on hold when RedWave charged tax — they indicated the shipment was recorded to a NJ ship-to but the bill shows tax applied. Please confirm whether this certificate is sufficient to clear the hold and to apply a refund/credit if necessary.

Attachment: BrightWave_NJ_SalesResaleCertificate.pdf (pdf)

Let me know if you need additional forms (CA ST-xxx or a signed affidavit). We can route anything directly to your finance team.

Thanks,
Megan Torres
Manager, Accounts Payable
BrightWave Logistics Inc.
megan.torres@brightwave.com
accounts-payable@brightwave.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Megan Torres <megan.torres@brightwave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sales tax certificate for Redwood invoice 4459 (NJ)

Megan — thanks for sending this over and for the quick turnaround. Quick read: the attached certificate covers BrightWave's NJ resale exemption, which would apply to shipments with NJ ship-to addresses. The invoice in question lists two line items shipped to a CA address, so our finance team needs either: (1) a CA resale certificate or CA-specific addendum showing coverage for the CA ship-to, or (2) a notarized exemption affidavit that references invoice 4459 and our tax policy so we can treat these particular line items as exempt.

I'm looping in Laura (finance) and Aditya (legal) so we can confirm what acceptable evidence is under Redwood policy. To make this fast, here's our internal affidavit template if you want to complete that instead: Attachment: redwood_exemption_affidavit_template.pdf

If BrightWave can provide a CA addendum showing coverage for the ship-to ZIP 94107, we can likely clear the hold without further steps. If not, we'll propose a short conditional release plan so you can get paid while we complete document validation.

Appreciate you moving on this today.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightWave: exemption evidence & plan to release invoice #4459

Team — I reviewed the NJ certificate and the CA addendum that BrightWave uploaded. Two notes from finance: (1) we require either a state-issued CA resale certificate or a notarized addendum that explicitly references the CA ship-to ZIP and the invoice numbers for a full retroactive credit. The addendum they've provided looks like a company cover letter rather than a notarized legal addendum. (2) For operational speed, we can do a conditional release of the carrier payment for invoice 4459 provided BrightWave executes the indemnity/affidavit and final notarized documents are received by EOD 2026-08-26. If the documents arrive after that date, accounting will process the refund on the next cycle but the hold will remain in place until validation is complete.

I've attached the hold notice for this invoice and a one-page conditional release template that we can sign to document expectations. Attachment: invoice_4459_hold_notice.pdf

Jonas — can you confirm BrightWave accepts the conditional release approach? Aditya, from legal: do we need any extra language beyond the standard indemnity if the CA form is replaced by a company addendum?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightWave: exemption evidence & plan to release invoice #4459 — legal signoff

Megan — thanks for working with us on this. I reviewed the CA addendum and BrightWave's NJ certificate. Legal is willing to accept the CA addendum for the purposes of clearing the carrier payment provided BrightWave: (a) signs the Redwood indemnity for potential retrospective tax exposure on the CA line items, and (b) the addendum is notarized within 5 business days. I've prepared the indemnity as a DocuSign packet to keep execution simple: https://www.docusign.com/link/indemnity-BW-4459 (Attachment: redwood_indemnity_docusign_link.txt).

Once we receive executed DocuSign and a notarized addendum (or a state-issued CA resale certificate), finance can process the invoice release and issue any required credit.

If you prefer, we can provisionally release the carrier payment immediately and hold the credit back until documentation is complete — please confirm which option BrightWave prefers.

Best regards,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
